description: This file defines the JSON schema and API interface for the 'Network' plugin, including methods, events, data structures, and documentation for managing network interfaces on a set-top box.

methods.name: getDefaultInterface
methods.description: Retrieves the default network interface used for external requests.

methods.name: getInterfaces
methods.description: Returns a list of supported network interfaces with their current state.

methods.name: getIPSettings
methods.description: Fetches IP configuration details for a specified interface.

methods.name: getNamedEndpoints
methods.description: Provides a list of supported endpoint names such as 'CMTS'.

methods.name: getQuirks
methods.description: Retrieves the standard string 'RDK-20093'.

methods.name: getStbIp
methods.description: Gets the IP address of the default network interface.

methods.name: getSTBIPFamily
methods.description: Gets the IP address of the default interface by address family.

methods.name: setConnectivityTestEndpoints
methods.description: Defines up to 5 endpoints for connectivity testing.

methods.name: isConnectedToInternet
methods.description: Checks if the device has internet connectivity.

methods.name: getInternetConnectionState
methods.description: Returns the current internet connection state.

methods.name: getCaptivePortalURI
methods.description: Returns the URI of the captive portal if connected.

methods.name: startConnectivityMonitoring
methods.description: Enables continuous internet connectivity monitoring.

methods.name: stopConnectivityMonitoring
methods.description: Stops the ongoing connectivity monitoring.

methods.name: isInterfaceEnabled
methods.description: Checks if a specific network interface is enabled.

methods.name: ping
methods.description: Pings a specified endpoint with a given number of packets.

methods.name: pingNamedEndpoint
methods.description: Pings a named endpoint resolved to a host or IP.

methods.name: setDefaultInterface
methods.description: Sets the default network interface.

methods.name: setInterfaceEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables a specific network interface.

methods.name: setIPSettings
methods.description: Configures IP settings for an interface.

methods.name: getPublicIP
methods.description: Retrieves the public IP address, optionally IPv6 or IPv4.

methods.name: setStunEndPoint
methods.description: Configures the STUN server endpoint for getPublicIP.

methods.name: configurePNI
methods.description: Enables or disables PNI connectivity testing.

methods.name: trace
methods.description: Performs traceroute to a specified endpoint.

methods.name: traceNamedEndpoint
methods.description: Performs traceroute to a named endpoint.
